physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-08.material: Muon ka dhashay jawiga sare ayaa si toosan hoos ugu socda dhulka xawaare $0.8c$. Qaab-dhismeedka Dhulka (dhulka) barta soo saarista waxay joogtaa dherer $800\,\mathrm{m}$, iyo cimriga celceliska muon-ka ee lagu cabbiray qaab-dhismeedkiisa nasashada waa $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Iyadoo $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, masaafada laga bilaabo barta soo saarista ilaa dhulka sida loogu arko qaab-dhismeedka nasashada muon-ka iyo waqtiga muon-ku qaadanayo si uu u dhammaystiro masaafadaas?

physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Muon ka dhashay jawiga sare ayaa si toosan hoos ugu socda dhulka xawaare $0.8c$. Iyadoo $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, masaafada laga bilaabo barta soo saarista ilaa dhulka sida loogu arko qaab-dhismeedka nasashada muon-ka iyo waqtiga muon-ku qaadanayo si uu u dhammaystiro masaafadaas?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\\gamma=1/\\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Gaabinta dhererka: $L=L_0/\\gamma=800\\cdot\\dfrac35=480\\,\\mathrm{m}$. Waqtiga $t=\\dfrac{L}{v}=\\dfrac{480}{0.8\\cdot3\\times10^8}=2.0\\times10^{-6}\\,\\mathrm{s}=2.0\\,\\mu\\mathrm{s}$, oo la simanyahay cimriga ugu habboon ee muon-ka. Indha-sidaha Dhulku wuxuu isla dhacdadaas u sharxaa dheereynta waqtiga: $\\Delta t=\\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\\,\\mu\\mathrm{s}=\\gamma\\cdot2.0\\,\\mu\\mathrm{s}$. Isku dhufashada $1333\\,\\mathrm{m}$ waxay bixisaa $\\gamma$ (doodda 1), isku dhufashada $v/c$ halkii waxay bixisaa $640\\,\\mathrm{m}$ (doodda 2), iska indho tirka gaabinta waxay bixisaa doodda 4.
